name: singlet_communication_differential_communication
title: Donor-aware differential communication
description: Tests which sender-receiver ligand-receptor interactions change between two conditions, with donors or samples as the unit of inference. The default multinichenet method sums cells to donor-by-cell-type pseudobulk, fits negative-binomial contrasts for ligands and receptors, and writes effect sizes, adjusted p-values and a weighted prioritisation score to uns/ccc_diff_results and uns/ccc_diff_prioritization. Needs raw counts in layers/counts, sample, donor, condition and cell-type columns, an LR resource, and several donors per condition. Do not use it for cell-level comparisons, single-donor conditions, or interaction strength within one condition (use communication.lr_interaction_scoring). Call with dry_run true first; tensor_cell2cell writes factors without p-values.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for tensor initialisation; the multinichenet method ignores it.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing ccc_diff members for the same contrast and method instead of failing.

method.description: multinichenet: default sample-level route with empirical null. tensor_cell2cell: donor-resolved factors, no p-values.

contrast.description: Condition contrast written test_vs_reference, for example treated_vs_control; both levels must exist.

design.description: Column names and donor settings for the design.

sample_key.description: obs column identifying the sample (one donor in one condition).

donor_key.description: obs column identifying the donor; the unit of inference.

condition_key.description: obs column holding the condition labels.

cell_type_key.description: obs column holding cell-type labels; each type is tested separately.

batch_keys.description: Optional batch covariates in the design (multinichenet only).

min_donors_per_group.description: Minimum donors per condition before a contrast is tested.

lr_resource.description: Ligand-receptor table in uns, or a resource name from communication.lr_resource_curation.

p_val_threshold.description: Significance cut-off used to flag triplets in tables and the summary.

fraction_cutoff.description: Minimum fraction of cells in a sample expressing a gene for it to count as expressed.

min_sample_prop.description: Fraction of samples in the smallest group that must express a gene.

min_cells.description: Minimum cells per sample and cell type for a pseudobulk observation.

scenario.description: Prioritisation weight scenario; regular weights all criteria equally.

ligand_activity_down.description: Include downregulated ligand activity in the prioritisation score.

logFC_threshold.description: Minimum absolute log fold change for the NicheNet target gene set.

empirical_pval.description: Calibrate p-values with an empirical null estimated from the test statistics.

top_n_target.description: Top predicted target genes kept per ligand for NicheNet links.

top_n_LR.description: Number of LR pairs kept in the output table.

rank.description: Fixed NN-CP rank; null runs an elbow search up to upper_rank.

upper_rank.description: Largest rank tried by the elbow search.

tf_init.description: Initialisation of the NN-CP factors; the choice is recorded in the output.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/ccc_diff_results. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, contrast, donors_per_group, triplets_tested, triplets_flagged, null_scale, device, seed. Completed runs only.
